notes.title: Update 1.1.0: New level, new cosmetics, and new achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1.0[/h1]
Celebrate the 1 year anniversary of EZGP with the biggest update to date! The game is also discounted at 25% off!

[h2]New level added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685035/ca9ac482f10a870da4ca1251d2dd920c2b712b3e.png[/img]
Suburbs have been added as a new level! This neighborhood has been a defensive position for many residents when the apocalypse began.

[h2]New cosmetics and achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685035/4a33a70bbaa6330abc5105a3364f3989caff5f4c.png[/img]
Four new skins have been added (one for each role). Each skin has a related achievement to unlock it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685035/b2fdfb76f6d4c3ca599a156c3ba9dcdd5f438703.png[/img]
Four new hats have been added, each one is already unlocked for everyone.

Steam Cloud support has also been added. Your save files should now be synced across devices.

notes.title: Patch 1.08 - Local co-op added
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added split-screen co-op for up to 2 players
[*] Reworked heavy weapons to be power-ups (can still be bought as store items using a difficulty modifier)
[*] Split rocket launcher into two different heavy weapons: RPG and Fireworks Launcher. Neither will have an upgrade anymore
[*] Buffed all heavy weapons
[*] Removed invulnerability for clown zombie when dodging attacks and increased their dodge speed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Streamlined user interface
[*] Nerfed heavy weapons
[*] Added helicopter flying cutscene during endgame
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Nerfed tier 3 shotgun
[*]Fixed an issue where grenades would get stuck inside a medkit
[*]Increased volume of flamethrower sounds
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added difficulty modifiers: you can now toggle certain settings to make the game easier or harder (for example, you can turn off health regeneration or turn on health pickups)
[*]New sound effects
[*]Added a move speed upgrade which can be used 3 times
[*]Increased healing speed from Medic's medkit
[*]Added infinite ammo to high calibre rounds for Tank and decreased time it will be active by 3 seconds
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Network optimizations
[*]Less predictable zombie movement
[*]Lowered max zombie count by 20%
[*]Added iframe when dodging
[*]Slowed backwards dodge
[*]Increased knife swing speed
[*]Fixed issues with bullets going through some walls
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Networking optimizations 
[*]Added vignette when low health
[*]Buffed shotguns
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix long usernames getting cut off in lobby and scoreboard
[*]Nerf flamethrower damage and increase cost to 4000
[*]Slower ranged enemy projectile velocity
[*]Ranged enemies no longer shoot while distracted by teddy bear
[*]Increase cooldown for Assault's grenades and Runner's teddy bear
[*]Added sounds for teddy bear, rocket launcher reloads, and grenade throws
[*]Added orange text for armor piercing rounds
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content: A small update has just released for the demo which should fix issues some players have experienced where the first wave would not end after killing all the zombies.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
A small update has been released to the demo. 

[list]
[*]Added 10 seconds in between waves to give time for buying weapons
[*]Added traditional camera view option
[*]High caliber bullets for Tank are now armor piercing and stop zombies from dodging attacks
[*]Rocket launcher projectiles now have slight aim assist
[*]Increased bullets fired out of upgraded shotgun from 5 to 7
[/list]
